scope: Actual clean install of the v1.2.0 installer ZIP on Linux x86_64. macOS, Windows, ARM64, native Microsoft PowerPoint and Agensi-hosted execution were not run.

artifact.name: goujian-strategy-slides-v1.2.0.zip
artifact.sha256: Recorded in the release SHA256SUMS.txt and out/v12-control/phase5-evidence.json after the final deterministic rebuild. The archive embeds this evidence file, so its own hash is intentionally not self-referenced here. This record documents the clean install of the pre-final deterministic build; the final rebuilt installer requires Codex's independent install check.

clean_path.description: The ZIP was extracted into a directory whose path contains a space and Chinese characters under the ignored out/v12-control/qoder-scratch area. The extracted repository tree had zero symlinks before bootstrap. The generated .venv and node_modules/.bin links are installation outputs and are not archive entries.

npm_isolation.userconfig: An empty NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG was used for the clean-install run.
npm_isolation.reason: The executed host has a global .npmrc containing an npm 11 allow-scripts array that project-scoped installs reject. Isolating user config proves the repository and lockfile do not depend on host-specific npm settings.

limitations: No native Microsoft PowerPoint, macOS, Windows, ARM64 or company-platform import was run.

Doctor presence checks and a successful render process are not visual approval. The separate 8-case/58-page final VQA is visual acceptance within its Linux LibreOffice scope, not native PowerPoint approval.
The clean-install run used an isolated empty npm user config because of the host's global npmrc; the lockfile itself resolves 23/23 tarballs from registry.npmjs.org.
The installer cannot be installed over an existing directory without stale-file risk; the migration guide requires a fresh folder.
The final rebuilt installer has not been clean-installed in this docs/package phase; Codex performs the independent final ZIP install check.
